content: A daily protein intake of 0.8 grams per kilogram of body weight is recommended to help slow the progression of chronic kidney disease (CKD). Consuming higher amounts of protein can accelerate the decline in kidney function, especially in individuals with advanced stages of CKD. Sodium intake should be tailored to the individual in order to manage blood pressure effectively and reduce cardiovascular risk. In many cases, sodium intake is restricted to levels below 2,300 milligrams per day.
